description: This file defines the UserService class which handles user creation, updating, and patching in a platform, interacting with repositories for users and authorization groups, and includes functionality for encoding passwords and logging.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class managing user operations such as creation, updating, and partial updates, utilizing repositories and security features.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user and associated authorization group after validating non-existence by username and email.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user details such as name, surname, email, and image URL.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Partially updates user details, specifically the 'detalle' field.
